# Claude Code System Prompt

The system prompt is the text that Claude Code sends to the model before your first message.
It tells the model how to behave and what the session looks like.
You can add to it, replace it, or switch to a shorter version.

## Example

You want the model to follow one more rule.
Run `claude --append-system-prompt "Always use TypeScript"`.
Claude Code adds the text to the end of the default prompt.

## Ways to Change It

Sources: [CLI Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cli-reference), [Output Styles](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/output-styles), and [Environment Variables](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars).

| Item | Mark | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--system-prompt <text>` | ✅ | Replaces the whole default prompt. |
| `--system-prompt-file <file>` | ✅ | Replaces the prompt with the text of a file. |
| `--append-system-prompt <text>` | ✅ | Adds text to the end of the prompt. |
| `--append-system-prompt-file <file>` | ✅ | Adds the text of a file to the end. |
| `--append-subagent-system-prompt` and `--append-subagent-system-prompt-file` | ✅ | Add text to every subagent prompt, in print mode only. |
| `--system-prompt-snapshot on\|off` | ✅ | `on` records the prompt on the first request and reuses it, and `off` rebuilds it for every request. |
| `--exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections` | ✅ | Moves the working folder, the environment, the memory paths, and the git status into the first user message. |
| `__SYSTEM_PROMPT_DYNAMIC_BOUNDARY__` | ✅ | A line in replacement text: text above it stays cached, and text below it can change. |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT` | ⚠️ | `1` chooses the short prompt, and `0` chooses the full prompt (see [Short or Full Prompt](#short-or-full-prompt)). |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE` and `--bare` | ✅ | Use a minimal prompt (see [Bare Mode](#bare-mode)). |
| Output style | ✅ | Adds style text, and `keep-coding-instructions` keeps the coding section (see [Output Styles](Claude-Code-Output-Styles)). |
| `prompt.section` and `prompt.compose` | ✅ | Mod events that rewrite one section or the whole list (see [Mod API](Claude-Code-Mod-API)). |

The flag `--system-prompt-snapshot` needs v2.1.257 or later.
The boundary line needs v2.1.275 or later.
The two `-file` flags and the subagent flags are hidden in `claude --help`.

## How Claude Code Builds It

Claude Code makes a list of sections.
Each section has a name and a text, or no text when its condition is false.
A `shared` section is the same for every user of a model.
A `session` section can change with the session.
Claude Code sends the `shared` sections first, so that the shared part can stay in the cache.
See [System Prompt Sections](Claude-Code-System-Prompt-Sections) for the list.

The request has three `system` blocks:
the attribution line (see [API Endpoints](Claude-Code-API-Endpoints#attribution-block)), the identity line, and the body.
See [Request Build](Claude-Code-Request-Build) for the cache markers.

## Short or Full Prompt

A model gets the short prompt (one `lean_body` section) or the full prompt (six longer sections).
Claude Code decides in this order:

1. `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT` set to a true value gives the short prompt.
2. `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT` set to `0`, `false`, `no`, or `off` gives the full prompt.
3. Server-set client data for the model decides next, when it exists.
4. A model whose name ends in `-eap`, and `claude-mythos-5`, get the short prompt.
5. A model whose name has `claude-3-`, `haiku`, or `sonnet`, and `claude-opus-4-0` to `claude-opus-4-7`, get the full prompt.
6. Any other model gets the short prompt on the Anthropic API, the Anthropic-run clouds, and gateways, and the full prompt on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and Mantle.

The docs say that Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 5, Opus 4.7, and earlier models get the full prompt, and newer models get the short one.
The bundle matches the names `haiku` and `sonnet`, so Haiku 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 also get the full prompt unless client data says otherwise.
That is why the row for `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT` has the mark ⚠️.

## Bare Mode

With `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE`, which `--bare` sets, the prompt has two lines:
`CWD: <path>` and `Date: <date>`.
Source: [Run Claude Code Programmatically](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/headless#start-faster-with-bare-mode) for the flag, and the bundle for the two lines (🔍).

## Subagent Prompt

A subagent gets its own agent text plus short notes.
The default agent text starts with `You are an agent for Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI for Claude.`
The notes say to share absolute paths, to avoid emojis, to avoid a colon before tool calls, and not to write report files.
Source: the bundle (🔍).
